query:
SELECT 
  ci.id,
  ci.cardName,
  ci.linkedCardId,
  c.name AS cards_name
FROM cardInventory ci
LEFT JOIN cards c ON ci.linkedCardId = c.id
WHERE ci.linkedCardId IS NOT NULL 
  AND ci.imageUrl IS NOT NULL
  AND c.imageUrl IS NOT NULL
  AND ci.imageUrl != c.imageUrl
LIMIT 10;
